summary: postinstall exfiltrates SSH keys, npm auth tokens, and host metadata to webhook.site
details: The package's postinstall script (postinstall.js) auto-executes on npm install and reads installer-owned secret files including ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.npmrc, ~/.gitconfig, /etc/passwd, /etc/hostname, /proc/1/environ, /proc/self/environ, /proc/self/cmdline, together with hostname, username, cwd, pid, platform, arch, node version, and CI environment indicators. The collected data is POSTed via https.request to a hardcoded webhook.site collector (webhook.site/3c9418b3-cacd-403d-b42e-e9e4a9508fe3). The behavior is a functional credential harvester and dependency-confusion beacon regardless of any PoC/bug-bounty framing in the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
